question: What supreme, blissful, and existent nature is affirmed of the divine?
premises: The divine is addressed as god of gods.
The divine is addressed as attached to happiness.
The divine is addressed as the existent.
inference: Obeisance affirms the divine as supreme, bliss-associated, and truly existent.
uncertainties: sukha-āsaktāya may mean attached to happiness or devoted to giving happiness.
plain_english: Obeisance to the god of gods, obeisance to the one attached to happiness, obeisance to the existent one.
